ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the current state of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the CMS investigation and the impact on the state's healthcare system.
questions: What is the current state of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How is the CMS investigation impacting the state's healthcare system?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the importance of vigilant oversight in the healthcare system.
